items.headline: ICJ: Myanmar ke khilaf narsanhar ka faisla
items.detail: ICJ ne faisla sunaya — Myanmar ki sena ne 2017 mein hazaaron Rohingya nagrik mare aur vyaapak yaun hinsa ki; adalat ne kuch mamalon mein 'genocidal intent' paya; sabooton ke anusaar lagbhag 10,000 Rohingya mare gaye.
items.exam_angle: ICJ aur 1948 Narsanhar Samjhauta — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Senegal ke kinare pravasi naav doobi, darjanon lapata
items.detail: Lagbhag 100 pravasiyon se bhari naav Dakar ke paas Yenne ke kinare palat gayi; kam se kam chaar shav mile, darjanon lapata hain aur talash jaari hai.
items.exam_angle: Paschim Africa se Atlantic marg par pravasi sankat — IOM ke anusar is saal 454 se zyada mautein ya lapata.

items.headline: Han Duck-soo ki saza radd, mamla dobara sunvai
items.detail: Dakshin Korea ki Supreme Court ne poorv PM Han Duck-soo ki 15 saal ki saza radd kar mamla Seoul High Court ko wapas bheja; ghoshna ke baad ke kuch aarop barkarar, hirasat do mahine badhai.
items.exam_angle: Dakshin Korea: 2024 martial law ke baad Yoon ko hataya gaya; Han par mukadma jaari — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.
items.image_credit: Michael Gruber / Austrian Foreign Ministry, Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 2.0)

items.headline: Denmark ne Greenland suraksha samjhota manzoor kiya
items.detail: Denmark ki sansad ne sarvasammati se America-Greenland suraksha samjhote ko manzoori di; America ko Greenland me do sainya adde banane ki ijazat milegi, 1951 ke samjhote ka vistaar hoga.
items.exam_angle: Greenland: Denmark ka swayatt-shasit kshetra; Arctic me America ki sainya upasthiti aur 1951 raksha sandhi.

items.headline: Trump, Xi, Putin ki pehli tri-pakshiya baithak
items.detail: Teeno neta APEC sammelan ke dauraan Shenzhen mein pehli baar ek saath mile; Xi ne baithak ko aitihasik bataya, agenda mein parmanu hathiyaar, Iran aur Ukraine yuddh hain.
items.exam_angle: APEC shikhar sammelan; New START sandhi February 2026 mein samapt — parmanu hathiyaar niyantran par charcha.

items.headline: Riyadh me Houthi hamle se PIF Tower kshatigrast
items.detail: Houthi missile ke khatre se nipatne ke dauran Riyadh ke King Abdullah Financial District me sthit 80-manzila PIF Tower ki facade kai manzilon par kshatigrast hui; Saudi gathbandhan ne malbe se nuksan ki pushti ki.
items.exam_angle: PIF: Saudi Arabia ka sovereign wealth fund; KAFD Riyadh ka vittiya jila.

items.headline: Bangladesh me Yunus ka ghar jalaya gaya
items.detail: Chattogram me Muhammad Yunus ke paitrik ghar aur Grameen Bank ki shakhaon me aag lagayi gayi; 28 jilon me kachche bam aur aagajani hui, kam se kam chaar log mare gaye.
items.exam_angle: Bangladesh: Hasina ko maut ki saza ke ek saal baad ashanti; Yunus antarim sarkar ke pramukh rahe.

items.headline: Hormuz sankat urja suraksha ko sabse bada khatra
items.detail: IEA ne apni World Energy Outlook me kaha — Hormuz sankat itihas me urja suraksha ke liye sabse bada khatra hai, 1970 ke tel sankat se bhi bada; 2.8 arab barrel tel aur 60 arab ghana meter gas ka nuksan hua.
items.exam_angle: IEA: Paris sthit antarrashtriya urja agency; yuddh se pehle duniya ke tel ka paanchva hissa Hormuz se guzarta tha.

items.headline: Khadi desh Iran yuddh rokne me jute
items.detail: Khadi desh, Pakistan aur Turkiye ne America se sampark kar Netanyahu ke Iran par hamle ke dabav ke khilaf yuddh rokne ki koshish tez ki; Mossad pramukh ki America yatra par bhi chinta jatai.
items.exam_angle: Paschim Asia me kootneeti aur Hormuz — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: GTA VI 13 saal baad duniya bhar me launch
items.detail: Rockstar ka GTA VI aaj PS5 aur Xbox par launch hua; presale me 17 million se zyada copies se 1.65 arab dollar ki kamai hui, Metacritic par 99 ka score mila.

items.headline: Haiti rashtrapati hatya: Miami me pastor doshi
items.detail: Miami ki federal adalat ne pastor Christian Sanon ko Haiti ke rashtrapati Jovenel Moise ki 2021 hatya ki sajish ke aath aaropon me doshi thahraya; 10 February ko saza sunayi jayegi, umar-kaid tak ho sakti hai.
items.exam_angle: Haiti: 2021 se koi rashtrapati nahi; America me 40 se zyada logon par aarop lage.

items.headline: Van Gogh ki painting $190.4 million me biki
items.detail: Sotheby's New York me Van Gogh ki 1890 ki 'Chataigniers en fleurs' $190.4 million me biki — kalakar ka ab tak ka sabse bada nilami record; Nazi kaal ke malikana vivad par samjhauta hua tha.
items.exam_angle: Nilami record aur sanskritik sampatti ka vivad — UPSC ke liye upyogi.
items.image_credit: Vincent van Gogh (Public domain, Wikimedia Commons)

items.headline: Trump Iran par naye hamle par vichar
items.detail: New York Times ki report ke mutabik Rashtrapati Trump Iran par naye bade hamlo par vichar kar rahe hain; Netanyahu chaar se saat din ke sanyukt hawai abhiyan ke liye dabav bana rahe hain, lekin abhi koi faisla nahi hua.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran tanav aur Hormuz: UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Peltola ne Alaska Senate seat jeeti
items.detail: Democrat Mary Peltola ne Alaska Senate chunav me Republican Dan Sullivan ko haraya; unki jeet se Senate me Democrats ki sankhya 56 ho gayi, aur ve Senate pahunchne wali pehli Alaska Native bani.
items.exam_angle: America ke midterm natije aur ranked-choice voting — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.
items.image_credit: Leah Herman / U.S. House of Representatives (Public domain, Wikimedia Commons)

items.headline: Gaza Yellow Line paar Israel ka ground operation
items.detail: Israeli tank budhvar ko Gaza me yuddhaviram rekha Yellow Line ke paar Nuseirat-Bureij ke paas pahunche, October 2025 ke yuddhaviram ke baad pehli baar; sena ne ise surang dhwast karne ki karvai bataya, Hamas ne ullanghan kaha.
items.exam_angle: Yellow Line: Gaza yuddhaviram ke tahat Israel-Hamas niyantran rekha.

items.headline: Anthropic ka $83 IPO, sabse bada tech listing
items.detail: AI company Anthropic ne apna IPO $83 prati share par tay kiya; 980 million share se $81.3 arab juta — ab tak ka sabse bada tech IPO, aaj Nasdaq par ANT ticker se trading shuru hogi.
items.exam_angle: IPO aur AI company ka pehla bada public listing — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

items.headline: Bayesian report: hawa ka khatra anjana tha
items.detail: Britain ki MAIB ne kaha superyacht Bayesian 2024 me Sicily ke paas tez hawa se 15 second me palat gayi thi, saat log mare gaye the; uski hawa se kamzori ka aaklan kabhi hua hi nahi tha, isliye chalak-dal ko khatre ka pata nahi tha.
items.exam_angle: Samudri suraksha jaanch aur MAIB ki bhoomika — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Machado ne Trump tel saude par sawal uthaye
items.detail: Venezuela ki vipaksh neta Maria Corina Machado ne America ke 100 arab dollar wale tel saude me pardarshita ki kami par sawal uthaye; kaha har saude ki dobara jaanch hogi, lekin America se lambi saajhedari zaroori hai.
items.exam_angle: Venezuela tel sauda aur America ki videsh neeti — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Hormuz me teen tanker mine se aag
items.detail: Iran ke anusar Hormuz ke poorv me teen tel tanker samudri mine se takrakar aag me ghire; Iran ka daava hai jahaz pratibandhit kshetra me the, swatantra pushti abhi nahi hui.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz: vishwa tel vyapar ka mahatvapurna jaladmarumadhya.

items.headline: Crimean Bridge par hafte me teesra hamla
items.detail: Crimea ke governor ke anusar is hafte teesri baar Crimean Bridge par hamle ke baad yatayat roka gaya; nuksan ka aaklan chal raha hai.
items.exam_angle: Kerch Bridge: Russia-Crimea ko jodne wala 19 km lamba pul.

items.headline: NSA outage se Middle East khufiya kaam thappa
items.detail: America ki National Security Agency ke network me do din se chal rahi gadbad se Georgia kendra me Middle East par khufiya kaam ruk gaya; NSANet band hua, lekin sabse samvedansheel pranaliyan chal rahi hain aur cyber hamle ki baat nahi hai.
items.exam_angle: America ki khufiya sanrachna aur cyber suraksha — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

items.headline: Iran ne Kuwait-Bahrain me US thikano par hamla
items.detail: Iran ke drone ne Kuwait ke Ali Al-Salem air base aur Bahrain me US sainya thikano ko nishana banaya; dono deshon ne hamle roke, koi nuksan ya hatahat ki khabar nahi.
items.exam_angle: Khadi me US sainya adde aur America-Iran tanav — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Google ne Gemini 4 Neon launch kiya
items.detail: Google ne 18 November ko Gemini 4 Neon model launch kiya — coding aur science kaam ke liye tez frontier model; API keemat $3 prati million input token, 1 million token context window.
items.exam_angle: AI models aur unki keemat — UPSC science-tech ke liye upyogi.

items.headline: America-Venezuela sainya saajhedari ka samjhota
items.detail: America ke raksha mantri Pete Hegseth ne Caracas ki achanak yatra me Venezuela ke saath sainya sahyog ka samjhota kiya; sanyukt prashikshan aur khufiya jaankari sajha karenge, antaram rashtrapati Delcy Rodriguez se bhi mile.
items.exam_angle: Venezuela me January me Maduro ko hatane ke baad America ka badhta prabhav — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.
